system.description:
You morph your visage into that of a faceless monstrosity known as Nyarlathotep. This visage can be of your own description as this monstrosity has no known singular description.

For the duration, any creature within 20 feet of you becomes unable to willingly move closer to you unless it makes a successful Wisdom saving throw at the start of its turn. Constructs and undead are immune to this effect.

Additionally, you gain advantage on saving throws to resist the Demoralized or Shaken conditions.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the radius by 5 feet.
